verdict.rationale: Khoj's privacy docs say you can self-host, generate embeddings locally, and use an offline chat model so your data never leaves your device (via Ollama and offline mode). That keeps data away from any third-party training pipeline, but the evidence contains no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out. Older community reports that chat sent data to OpenAI predate the documented offline chat, so they don't contradict current docs. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that user data isn't used for model training, a training policy for Khoj Cloud, guidance on training use when commercial API models (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) are configured, and independent verification of the offline no-data-egress claim.
